usage: The word 燒臘 (siu1 laap6) is a noun referring to Cantonese-style roast and preserved meats.
It is commonly used to name dishes or types of food sold in restaurants and markets.
You can use 燒臘 as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about food.
It doesn’t have verb or adjective forms, so it always functions as a noun.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 soeng2 sik6 siu1 laap6 faan6
examples.meaning: I want to eat roast meat rice today.

examples.sentence: 呢間餐廳賣嘅燒臘好正。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 maai6 ge3 siu1 laap6 hou2 zing3
examples.meaning: The roast meats sold at this restaurant are very good.

examples.jyutping: siu1 laap6 jau5 siu1 aap3 tung4 siu1 juk6
examples.meaning: Roast meats include roast duck and roast pork.

examples.sentence: 佢每日都買燒臘返屋企食。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 maai5 siu1 laap6 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6
examples.meaning: He buys roast meat to eat at home every day.
